overview.en:
Research brands, ads, audiences, trends, and workspaces through Waldo's official curated strategy MCP.

Research brand discussion and market context before preparing a strategy brief. Preserve source references and distinguish reported observations from strategic interpretation.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
研究品牌、广告、受众与趋势，整理策略工作区。

在准备策略简报前研究品牌讨论与市场背景，保留来源，并区分已观测信息与策略解读。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available discussion and findings about this brand.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总围绕这个品牌的可用讨论与发现。

starterPrompts.en: Research this campaign topic and identify themes supported by sources.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 研究这个活动主题，找出有来源支持的趋势。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a brand strategy brief with evidence and open questions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备品牌策略简报，包含依据与待确认问题。
